Q: Why does cognito inbound federation lambda trigger ignore custom fields in userAttributesToMap? A:

Edited the google mappings:

I added my custom:work_role attribute, and mapped it to custom:work_role. On my next test everything came over as expected. The mapping happens after the lambda and filters out everything not explicitly mapped.

Q: Lighten RGB with pure CSS A:

Fast forward a few years, you can now do

background-color: hsl(from #37beff h s calc(l - 35));

in CSS and from my cursory tests, it does what darken(#37beff, 35%) does in less. (And since it's all CSS, you should be able to use vars for the color value and offset, I've just not gotten around to double-checking that. To lighten, do l + amount.)
